# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and teacher  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c1 P7](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0007), [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v2 c2 P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v3 c4 P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora has fair, ethereal, pale hair and large, blue eyes. She is exceptionally tall, standing two inches taller than most other girls at college, which sometimes makes her feel oversized.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000), [v3 c4 P10](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0010)_

## Personality

Despite her fair and delicate appearance, Honora is full of mischief, jokes, and humor. She is a thoughtful, imaginative, and studious person who values deep friendship, spiritual beauty, and poetry. She excels in her academic pursuits while maintaining a cheerful, grounded, and loyal nature.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c26 P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)_

- Mischievous and humorous  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- Achieve high honors and excel in her studies at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c37 P0](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0000)</sub>
- Establish a independent home with her friends in Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036)</sub>

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy and studied alongside Nell Harcourt, excelling in languages and classical branches. After graduating, she taught school at Delford before enrolling at Wexcombe College. At Wexcombe, she formed a close circle of friends with Nell Harcourt, Mabel Colby, and Cressida Lindsay. Together with Nell, Mabel, and Cressy, she helped set up an independent household at 'Tabby's Place' in Portmaris. During her time at college, she achieved High Honors in Classics and formed lasting friendships before graduating with her Bachelor of Arts degree.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c1 P7](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0007), [v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036), [v3 c37 P0](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0000)_

## Quotes

> I think that if it were possible to see a kiss, its appearance would resemble a violet.  <sub>[v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011)</sub>

> If we but possess the vision to perceive it, the soul to cherish it, and the reach to claim it for our own, the world offers us so very much—an abundance within mankind, an abundance within creative works and writings, an abundance in every place to bring joy and inspire gratitude.  <sub>[v3 c37 P22](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0022)</sub>
